title: Pentaryn Rules Lookup
description: Full-text search across the owned rulebooks, from one call. Exposes game.pentaryn.rules.search() / .page() / .monster() / .packs() / .selftest(). Read-only: it never writes a document. Searches the Player's Handbook, Dungeon Master's Guide and 2024 SRD by default; Monster Manual text and the 2014 SRD are opt-in, and 2014 hits are stamped with their edition so they cannot be mistaken for current rules. Every hit carries a pasteable Compendium UUID.
